title: Representative tensor normalizations for the core reduction
statement: Fix a prime ℓ, a finite extension E/ℚ_ℓ and a scheme W. Given a core coefficient reduction record R with tensor subrecord T and its finite quotient calculus Q, the reduction tensor, finite tensor, evaluation tensor and reduction/evaluation comparison satisfy their prescribed K-flat representative normalization predicates.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 06YY and 0941; simultaneous K-flat representative tensor comparisons

proof.text: Use canonical tensor pullback for the reduction and the normalized scalar-derived pair at each finite level. Evaluate all comparisons on simultaneous K-flat representatives, where they are ordinary pure-tensor maps. Uniqueness of the prescribed scalar and evaluation comparisons gives the finite and evaluation squares; evaluating the strict reduction square gives the reduction/evaluation identity.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4, 06YY and 0941; simultaneous K-flat representative tensor comparisons

lean.statement:
theorem coefficientNormalizedReductionNormalizations
    (T : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E W)
    (R : CoefficientDerivedSystemReduction l E W)
    (hRT : R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors = T)
    (Q : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E W R.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors) :
    CoefficientReductionTensorNormalization l E W R ∧
      CoefficientFiniteTensorNormalization l E W R ∧
      CoefficientEvaluationTensorNormalization l E W R ∧
      CoefficientReductionTensorEvaluation l E W R
